mapper.insert:
insert into `dispatch_device`(id,name,code,password,type,user_id, tenant,deleted,create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time) values
(#{item.id},#{item.name},#{item.code},#{item.password},#{item.type},#{item.userId}, #{item.tenant},#{item.deleted},#{item.createBy},#{item.createTime},#{item.updateBy},#{item.updateTime})
on duplicate key update name = values(name), password = values(password), type = values(type), update_time = values(update_time)
mapper.select:
select d.id, d.code, d.`name`, d.type, d.user_id, d.create_time, s.online_status, s.video_status, s.lng, s.lat, s.direction, s.speed, s.upload_time, s.tenant from dispatch_device d LEFT JOIN dispatch_device_status s on d.id = s.id
d.type != 10
and ( d.name like concat('%',#{param.name},'%') or d.code like concat('%',#{param.name},'%') )
and d.code like concat('%',#{param.code},'%')
and d.type = #{param.type}
and s.online_status = #{param.onlineStatus}
order by s.upload_time desc
select g.id,g.parent_id,g.`code`,g.`name`,g.type,g.valid_time,g.sort from dispatch_device_group_refer r left join dispatch_group g on r.group_id = g.id where r.device_id = #{deviceId}

select d.id,d.name,d.code,d.type,d.user_id,s.online_status,s.lat,s.lng,s.speed,s.direction,s.upload_time from dispatch_device d inner join dispatch_device_group_refer r on d.id = r.device_id left join dispatch_device_status s on d.id = s.id where r.group_id = #{groupId}
